# NORD-10 Input/Output bus at an I/O device card position

Machine NORD-10 · catalogue file [catalog/signals/nd-bus-nord10.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/signals/nd-bus-nord10.json) · format and background in [Bus signals and connectors](../../BUS-SIGNALS.md)

## How to read the table

- **active**: low = true when the line is low (ND suffix 0); high = true when high (suffix 1); none = power
- **direction**: seen from an I/O card: in, out, bidir, 'out, open collector (shared)'
- **confidence**: read = stated in the source; inferred = worked out, the note says from what; open = not known
- **pins**: connector 'open' = no NORD-10 document found names the connector; pin = the number in the wiring list and on the card drawings
- **letters**: In Backwiring til NORD-10 a letter before a signal code (W, G, B, E, X) is printed. G marks the driving pin (inferred from the IDENT/GRANT chains); X marks a signal with only one connection (inferred from the chain ends); W, B and E are open.
- **level**: electrical kind from ND-06.012.01 figure 7.4: 'tri-state TTL' or 'open collector'

## Signals

### address

| Signal | Pins | Active | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [BA0](#ba0) | 32 | low | in | Bus address bit 0. With IOX the device register address is 11 bits (bits 0-10). |
| [BA1](#ba1) | 33 | low | in | Bus address bit 1. With IOX the device register address is 11 bits (bits 0-10). |
| [BA2](#ba2) | 34 | low | in | Bus address bit 2. With IOX the device register address is 11 bits (bits 0-10). |
| [BA3](#ba3) | 36 | low | in | Bus address bit 3. With IOX the device register address is 11 bits (bits 0-10). |
| [BA4](#ba4) | 37 | low | in | Bus address bit 4. With IOX the device register address is 11 bits (bits 0-10). |
| [BA5](#ba5) | 38 | low | in | Bus address bit 5. With IOX the device register address is 11 bits (bits 0-10). |
| [BA6](#ba6) | 40 | low | in | Bus address bit 6. With IOX the device register address is 11 bits (bits 0-10). |
| [BA7](#ba7) | 41 | low | in | Bus address bit 7. With IOX the device register address is 11 bits (bits 0-10). |
| [BA8](#ba8) | 42 | low | in | Bus address bit 8. With IOX the device register address is 11 bits (bits 0-10). |
| [BA9](#ba9) | 44 | low | in | Bus address bit 9. With IOX the device register address is 11 bits (bits 0-10). |
| [BA10](#ba10) | 45 | low | in | Bus address bit 10. With IOX the device register address is 11 bits (bits 0-10). |

### control

| Signal | Pins | Active | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [BIOXE](#bioxe) | 11 | low | in | IOX enable: the strobe that tells every card that an IOX transfer is under way, so the card compares BA against its own address. |
| [BINPUT](#binput) | 15 | low | out, open collector (shared) | The addressed card says the transfer is an input (card to CPU). |
| [BCON](#bcon) | 23 | low | out, open collector (shared) | The card answers that it recognised its address (connected). |
| [BGRANT / GRANTn (chain in)](#bgrant--grantn-chain-in) | 9 | low | in | open |
| [GRANTn (chain out)](#grantn-chain-out) | 8 | low | out | open |
| [BMCL](#bmcl) | 55 | low | in | Master clear: resets the card. |
| [RESTART](#restart) | 19 | low | open | open |
| [IOTE](#iote) | 47 | low | in | open |
| [BSKIP](#bskip) | 51 | low | out | open |
| [BFQ1](#bfq1) | 4 | high | in | A clock the card uses in test mode in place of the modem clocks. |
| [BFQ2](#bfq2) | 5 | low | open | open |

### interrupt

| Signal | Pins | Active | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [BINT10](#bint10) | 27 | low | out, open collector (shared) | Interrupt request on program level 10. Levels 15, 13, 12, 11 and 10 are the ones available to external devices. |
| [BINT11](#bint11) | 31 | low | out, open collector (shared) | Interrupt request on program level 11. Levels 15, 13, 12, 11 and 10 are the ones available to external devices. |
| [BINT12](#bint12) | 35 | low | out, open collector (shared) | Interrupt request on program level 12. Levels 15, 13, 12, 11 and 10 are the ones available to external devices. |
| [BINT13](#bint13) | 39 | low | out, open collector (shared) | Interrupt request on program level 13. Levels 15, 13, 12, 11 and 10 are the ones available to external devices. |
| [BINT15](#bint15) | 43 | low | out, open collector (shared) | Interrupt request on program level 15. Levels 15, 13, 12, 11 and 10 are the ones available to external devices. |

### ident

| Signal | Pins | Active | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [BIDENT / IDENTn (chain in)](#bident--identn-chain-in) | 7 | low | in | IDENT search signal coming in from the card nearer the CPU. When several cards interrupt on the same level, the slot position decides priority; a card that answers IDENT turns off its interrupt. |
| [IDENTn (chain out)](#identn-chain-out) | 6 | low | out | IDENT search passed on to the next card further from the CPU (when this card does not answer). |

### power

| Signal | Pins | Active | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [-12V](#-12v) | 62, 63 | none | out | -12 V made on the 2A50 card by its own VP12/12 converter and put out on the cable side. |
| [+12V](#12v) | 66, 67 | none | out | +12 V made on the 2A50 card by its own VP12/12 converter and put out on the cable side. |
| [GND](#gnd) | 2, 3, 96, 97, 80, 82, 84, 86, 94 | none | in | Ground: 2, 3, 96, 97 from the backplane; 80, 82, 84, 86, 94 are 2A50's cable-side grounds. |
| [+5V](#5v) | 0, 1, 98, 99 | none | in | +5 V logic supply. |

| F612 | ND manual ND-06.012.01: figure 3.1 'I/O slot/plug layout' (page 3-3) and figure 7.4 'Signal distribution I/O bus B and C rack' (section 7.4) | Read from the owner's screenshots of the two figures (2026-11-24); the rest of the manual has not been read here. Figure 7.4 is drawn for the 'I/O bus B and C rack'; whether that rack is wired exactly like the I/O positions A25-A32 of the CPU crate in Backwiring til NORD-10 is OPEN - where the two disagree (pins 6-9, 19, 47, 51) both readings are kept and named. |
